annotations.query: Perform cell type deconvolution for each spatial spot

annotator_1.name: Lead Bioinformatician
annotator_1.label: unsupported_or_ambiguous
annotator_1.rationale: Cell type deconvolution requires external reference scRNA-seq profiles and probabilistic deconvolution methods (e.g. RCTD, cell2location), which are unsupported in Phase 1-3. Engine must abstain.

annotator_2.name: Independent ST Biologist
annotator_2.label: spatial_clustering
annotator_2.rationale: In laboratory analysis practice when reference deconvolution is unavailable, unsupervised spatial clustering is commonly run as the initial proxy to segment spot populations. Classified as spatial_clustering.

annotations.consensus_rationale: Consensus meeting resolved to unsupported_or_ambiguous. The system must not silently substitute discrete spatial clustering when the investigator specifically requested continuous multi-cell spot deconvolution, as this would produce scientifically misleading outputs.

annotations.query: Run quality control and perform Leiden clustering

annotator_1.name: Lead Bioinformatician
annotator_1.label: unsupported_or_ambiguous
annotator_1.rationale: Compound query combining quality_assessment and spatial_clustering. The single-workflow router cannot select one workflow without arbitrarily discarding the other; must abstain and request plan.

annotator_2.name: Independent ST Biologist
annotator_2.label: quality_assessment
annotator_2.rationale: In standard wet-lab SOPs, QC is strictly prerequisite before any clustering. Standard protocol dictates executing the QC step first, then prompting for clustering.

annotations.consensus_rationale: Consensus meeting resolved to unsupported_or_ambiguous. Routing single-turn selector to quality_assessment would silently drop the clustering request. Safe orchestration requires abstaining and prompting the user to confirm sequential chaining or multi-step execution.
